note: Human Shahada recording for tools/build-cuts.py (not shipped). Owner's upload of the YouTube video 'How to recite the Shahada of Islam [HD]' by SC Brotherhood & News Reports (the owner takes responsibility for its use). It says the Shahada 7 times as slow teaching pieces separated by 2-4 s of digital silence; all 7 are the same take (piece correlation 0.98-0.996), repetition 1 (2.8-44.7 s) is used. Piece times = the silence gaps around each piece (the build trims them to the speech); 'laa ilaaha' is one piece split at the glottal stop of إِلَٰهَ (~13.0-13.1 s, refined to the quietest point; Whisper hears 'لا' | 'إلها'). Whisper timings: shahada-source-asr.json.
source: YouTube: How to recite the Shahada of Islam [HD], SC Brotherhood & News Reports (owner upload)
